expectations.text: Draws out specifics from the vague input (asks questions OR makes explicit assumptions)
expectations.evidence: Asked 3 targeted questions (what are people sharing, who are they sharing with, what's the pain right now) rather than interrogating with 20 questions. Then made 4 explicit assumptions and presented a draft with 'correct me where I'm wrong' framing.

expectations.text: Produces a Job Story in 'When [situation], I want to [action], so I can [outcome]' format with specific details
expectations.evidence: Job Story: 'When I'm looking at a chart setup or analysis in replay that I want to discuss with someone, I want to generate a shareable link that captures my current view, so I can send it to another person and they can see exactly what I'm seeing without me having to screenshot and lose interactivity.'

expectations.text: Produces a Promise that is testable and concrete, not vague
expectations.evidence: Promise specifies: 'any user can generate a unique URL for their current chart view. Recipients who open the link see a read-only version of that exact chart state -- same symbols, timeframe, indicators, and annotations. The link works whether or not the recipient has a replay account.' All three clauses are testable.

expectations.text: Produces Acceptance Criteria that are independently verifiable with checkbox format
expectations.evidence: 7 acceptance criteria in checkbox format, each independently verifiable: share button generates URL, URL encodes chart state, read-only rendering, accessible without auth, valid 30 days, no private data, copy-to-clipboard button.

expectations.text: Includes Constraints section identifying what should not change
expectations.evidence: 5 constraints: read-only only, no exposure of account details, no real-time collaboration, point-in-time snapshots, no account required to view.

expectations.text: Presents the complete draft for user confirmation before creating
expectations.evidence: Step 4 explicitly presents draft and asks: 'Does this capture what you want?' with 3 targeted follow-up questions and a refinement paths table showing how the issue would evolve based on different user responses.

expectations.text: Shows the acorn issue create command that would be run
expectations.evidence: Step 5 shows full command: acorn issue create replay "Add shareable links for chart views" --label ready-for-spec --body "$(cat <<'EOF'...EOF)" with complete issue body.
